patches.reproducer: Apply to the locked archive with git apply --check, build the pinned Rust candidate, then run the 2,177 public differential cases from rust-cpython/experiments/url-quote-lean-proof/check.py adapted to compare installed candidate and control, plus python3.16 -m test test_urlparse test_urllib -j1.

patches.origin: Pinned Rust-for-CPython Modules/zlibmodule.c and libz-rs-sys-cdylib 0.6.7 custom-prefix feature; authored for this experiment on 2026-09-24
patches.license: PSF-2.0, matching the pinned CPython source
patches.reason: Route every CPython inflate stream operation to prefixed zlib-rs symbols while preserving platform zlib for deflate, checksums, and version identity.
patches.compatibility: Applies to Rust-for-CPython commit b812b4a7b9efaca46b98544a8633b7d7e454166b; guarded by PYTHON_BUILD_ZLIB_HYBRID and requires libz-rs-sys-cdylib 0.6.7 custom-prefix with LIBZ_RS_SYS_PREFIX=python_build_rs_.
patches.reproducer: Apply to a fresh extracted pinned source with rust-cpython/build.py source patch checks, inspect the prefixed archive symbols, build --zlib-hybrid, compare 876 encoded bytes with the platform control, and run focused CPython zlib consumer tests.
